methodology.field_accuracy: Exact match after documented normalization. Explicit null labels count in the denominator and match only a null extraction. unreadable_fields and skipped_fields are excluded from field accuracy and separately identified by the manifest. Processing failures remain in the denominator unless fields are explicitly skipped.
methodology.processing_success: Stored worker document status completed and processor status completed or completed_with_errors. A captured OCR page error still counts as a completed document pipeline, but its missing invoice fields count as extraction misses.
methodology.failure_rate: Failed or not-queued documents divided by all manifest documents.
methodology.timing: Worker started_at to completed_at in the isolated SQLite run; PDF page time divides by pages actually processed. Includes extraction persistence pipeline duration as recorded by job timestamps.
methodology.validation: Known validation codes must appear in persisted structured validation findings. Duplicate checks compare normalized supplier plus invoice identifier; equal amount alone is not considered a duplicate.
